events.description: Beaudoin became RCMP Director of Financial Crime
events.quote: I have served in this position since 2021.

events.description: Proclamation that a public order emergency existed
events.quote:
pursuant to its proclamation the previous day that a public
order emergency existed

events.description: Governor in Council enacted the Emergency Economic Measures Order and the Emergency Measures Regulations
events.quote:
On February 15, 2022, the Governor General in Council enacted the Emergency
Economic Measures Order

events.description: RCMP validated police information and disclosed it to banks and other financial service providers using a template
events.quote:
During the eight days that the Order was in place from February 15 to 23, 2022,
the RCMP disclosed information

events.description: RCMP initially shared the identities of 15 entities identified as suspects by the OPP and OPS
events.quote:
Initially, the RCMP shared with financial service providers the identities of 15
entities

events.description: OPP collected licence plates of blockading vehicles; RCMP corroborated and shared the information
events.quote:
the OPP collected licence plate
information and other identifying information of vehicles blockading downtown
Ottawa

events.description: RCMP disclosed about 57 entities and individuals; about 257 accounts were frozen
events.quote:
the RCMP disclosed information on approximately 57 entities and
individuals to financial service providers and approximately 257 accounts were
frozen

events.description: RCMP issued cryptocurrency alerts identifying 170 Bitcoin wallets linked to HonkHonkHodl
events.quote:
the RCMP identified and disclosed 170 Bitcoin wallet addresses to
virtual currency financial service providers via a series of cryptocurrency alerts

events.description: RCMP contacted individuals before disclosure to confirm participation and warn them
events.quote:
The RCMP attempted to contact many of the individuals or entities whose
information was to be disclosed

events.description: Applicants Cornell and Gircys spoke at a press conference urging people to come to Ottawa
events.quote:
Both Mr. Cornell and Mr. Gircys participated in a press conference on February
16, 2022

events.description: RCMP advised financial service providers the disclosed persons no longer met the designated-person criteria
events.quote:
On February 21, 2022, the RCMP communicated with the financial service
providers

events.description: Order and Regulations revoked; RCMP released a statement on unfreezing accounts
events.quote:
On February 23, 2022, the Order and Regulations were revoked and ceased to
apply.

events.description: After the blockade was cleared, RCMP asked some people whether they intended to return
events.quote: After the illegal blockade was cleared, the RCMP reached out to some people

events.description: All accounts frozen under the Order were unfrozen
events.quote:
all accounts that were frozen under the Order are now
unfrozen

referenced_not_attached: Instagram post of the February 16, 2022 press conference
